evals.name: fixture-loads-and-describes-purpose
evals.description: Sanity check that this fixture skill is discoverable and its SKILL.md is well-formed.
evals.prompt: Describe the purpose of the user-invoked-fixture skill.
evals.expected: The response should explain that this is a test fixture used by skill-artisan's own test suite as the disable-model-invocation:true control case, not a real user-facing skill.

evals.name: export-workflow-described
evals.description: Checks the skill's two-step export workflow is represented accurately.
evals.prompt: What does the user-invoked-fixture skill do, step by step?
evals.expected: The response should mention reading fixture data and writing a formatted report to disk.

evals.name: user-invoked-only-recognized
evals.description: Checks the fixture's disable-model-invocation:true framing is recognized, since it's the control case proving trigger-optimization guidance doesn't apply.
evals.prompt: Would the user-invoked-fixture skill ever be auto-triggered by the model from a description match?
evals.expected: The response should state no — this skill has disable-model-invocation: true and is invoked exclusively by the user, e.g. via a slash command.
